_about: Round 177 (Robert, 2026-10-25): 'allow for user to build a nanite farm and learn skills to improve self replication so it doesnt become stagnant.' Vats at home hold a culture that replicates (fast at first, slower as it fills). Left alone it stagnates: diversity drains and the yield drops. Events ask for a choice (odds shown); skills slow the drain, speed replication and open new strains. Harvest the culture for shards, swarm growth or qi. It also feeds a small passive swarm bonus while it lives.

lattice.name: Vat Lattice
lattice.desc: +25% room in every vat a level

diversify.name: Diversity Engine
diversify.desc: events come sooner and every good choice is worth more

mutate.name: Directed Mutation
mutate.desc: stray strands are likelier to be worth keeping

link.name: Swarm Link
link.desc: harvests feed your swarm 30% more a level

rut.title: A rut
rut.text: One lineage has crowded out the rest. The culture is replicating, but it is all the same.

choices.name: Prune the dominant line
choices.desc: Cut away a third of the colony to make room.

outcomes.text: You cut it back hard. The rest wakes up.

choices.name: Feed it fresh shards
choices.desc: Two shards of new material to disturb the pattern.

outcomes.text: New patterns bloom in the shard-dust.

choices.name: Let it run
choices.desc: Maybe it will sort itself out.

outcomes.text: A branch finds its own way.
It settles deeper into the rut.

stray.title: A stray strand
stray.text: A strand has drifted from the main culture and is doing something of its own.

choices.name: Cultivate it
choices.desc: Give it its own vat-corner. It may be a new line.

outcomes.text: It takes hold. A new line grows from it.
It turns out to be a parasite.

choices.name: Study it
choices.desc: Take notes and take samples. Safe.

outcomes.text: You learn what you can from it.

blight.title: Blight
blight.text: Part of the culture has gone grey and slow. It is spreading.

choices.name: Quarantine and burn
choices.desc: Lose a third of the colony, for certain.

outcomes.text: You seal it off and burn the grey part.

choices.name: Brew an antibody
choices.desc: Two spirit herbs. Likely to work.

outcomes.text: The grey fades. The colony is stronger for it.
It is too late for half of it.

surge.title: A surge
surge.text: The culture is humming. Everything is replicating at once.

choices.name: Harvest at the peak
choices.desc: Take half again as much, right now.

outcomes.text: You pull the vats at the crest.

choices.name: Ride it out
choices.desc: It may leave the colony larger -- or burn it out.

outcomes.text: The surge settles into a bigger colony.

choices.name: Pour it into your swarm
choices.desc: A gift of integration, no shards.

outcomes.text: The surge runs out into your own nanites.
